verbs.name: import.otio
verbs.description: Preview or atomically import a foreign OpenTimelineIO (.otio) timeline. `mode:"preview"` performs a bounded (16 MiB), read-only structure/count/media-availability pass and returns a SHA-256 `source_hash`; `mode:"replace"` (default) optionally requires that hash, probes every available referenced media file before mutation, then adds new assets and replaces the active timeline in ONE replay-safe, undoable `import.otio` op. Missing media clips are preserved as timed gaps with an `otio_media_missing` warning. Unsupported nested stacks/transitions/effects/markers, disabled or cropped items, generated media references, invalid time values, wrong media kinds, source ranges beyond media duration, remote file authorities, and non-file URI schemes are refused rather than silently dropped. The current project format is preserved; source geometry is reported for an explicit later project.format decision. Caption tracks are not in OTIO.

mode.description: preview is read-only; replace is the default atomic timeline import

expected_hash.description: Optional source_hash returned by preview; replace conflicts if file bytes changed

verbs.result: preview -> {status:"preview", source_hash, tracks, track_count, clips, gaps, media_available, media_missing, missing_sources, source_format, format_policy:"preserve_project"}; replace -> {status:"imported", source_hash, tracks_created, clips_inserted, gaps, missing_clips, assets_imported, assets_reused, jobs, source_format, format_policy:"preserve_project"} with one op id; warns `otio_media_missing` when missing clips became timed gaps
